title: Home Mortgage Loans: PMI cancellation and automatic termination thresholds
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: PMI cancellation and automatic termination thresholds

This document lists, for each Home Mortgage Loans program, the loan-to-value ratio (LTV) at which a borrower may request cancellation of private mortgage insurance (PMI), the scheduled LTV at which PMI terminates automatically, and the two late-payment look-back periods a borrower-requested cancellation uses. All LTV figures here are measured on the original property value.

## Thresholds by program

| Program | LTV at which the borrower may request cancellation (%) | Scheduled LTV at which PMI terminates automatically (%) | Look-back with no payment 30 or more days late (months before the request) | Look-back with no payment 60 or more days late (months before the request) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 | 78 | 12 | 24 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 | 78 | 12 | 24 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 80 | 78 | 12 | 24 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |

"Not applicable" means the program sets no value for that threshold.

## Meaning of each column

- **Request LTV** is the loan-to-value, on original value, at which the borrower may request PMI cancellation.
- **Automatic termination LTV** is the scheduled loan-to-value, on original value, at which PMI terminates automatically.
- **30-day look-back** is the number of months before the request that must contain no payment 30 or more days late.
- **60-day look-back** is the number of months before the request that must contain no payment 60 or more days late.

## Basis Q&A

- **Are the request level and the automatic level the same?** No. In the three programs that set them, a borrower may request cancellation at 80 percent, while automatic termination is set at a scheduled 78 percent.
- **How far back does the 60-day look-back reach for a Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage?** 24 months before the request.
- **How far back does the 30-day look-back reach for a 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage?** 12 months before the request.
- **Hypothetical case.** A Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage loan measures 79 percent of original value. That figure is below the program's request LTV of 80 and still above its automatic termination LTV of 78.
